{
  "title": "Risks and assumptions",
  "text": "The main risks to this proposal include the document exceeding 20 pages or portal congestion delaying the upload past 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC [RSK-001], integration delays with the College's student records system breaching REQ-0014 [RSK-002], and users failing to locate older documents during the transitional period [RSK-003]. To respond, we enforce an 18-page budget immediately and upload 24 hours prior to the deadline, retaining the submission receipt [RSK-001]. We also initiate a mock API integration based on published specifications prior to contract award and establish a daily standup with the College's IT department [RSK-002], alongside providing a unified search interface or clear documentation and accelerating the migration of frequently accessed records ahead of the 2027-02-28 target [RSK-003]. Open questions remain regarding whether templates for the twelve most used forms should be included and their format [Q-01], the volume of signed records to be migrated by 2027-02-28 and the current tool's data structure [Q-02], whether the optional on-premises deployment should be priced separately and its infrastructure requirements [Q-03], the specific communication channel for severity-one incidents [Q-04], expected transaction volume and concurrency on 2027-01-11 [Q-05], and the availability of REST API specifications and sandbox environments prior to bid submission [Q-06].",
